cases.name: Lakisha Quintel "Kisha" Owens
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She accepted Christ at an early age on March 20, 1983, at Mount Carmel Missionary Baptist Church. She later became a member of Christian Fellowship Baptist Church. Kisha was very hardworking and enjoyed reading. She loved fashion and jewelry and had a special place in her heart for children. Kisha’s family and friends were very important in her life."
